root_cause: During terminal pricing recovery, queued/pending GitHub Actions were repeatedly mistaken for evidence that the candidate itself still required modification. Each unnecessary write changed the PR head SHA, cancelled or superseded exact-head checks, and extended the delivery instead of resolving it. Queue state is an infrastructure scheduling state, not a code defect.
prevention: A stable candidate with only queued/pending checks must remain immutable.
Do not create a new commit, recovery branch or replacement PR solely because GitHub runners are queued or pending.
Only concrete failed-step evidence, a proven merge conflict, or explicit terminal writer-lease drift may justify candidate mutation.
For STALE_QUEUE_RECOVERY, the supervisor may cancel stale workflow runs and re-dispatch exact-head Required/BRAIN checks, but must not mutate the candidate branch.
For LONG_RUNNING_OBSERVE, preserve the exact head unless concrete stalled-job evidence exists.
Same-lineage branch refresh is restricted to MERGE_CONFLICT_RECOVERY with an active TERMINAL_DELIVERY writer lease.
After any legitimate head mutation, discard all prior-head workflow evidence and evaluate only the new exact head.

evidence.observed_failure_mode: Repeated head churn while Required/BRAIN/SEO/CodeQL jobs were only queued or pending.
